name: Databend
description: Validate access to Databend and its metadata.

steps.name: CheckAccess
steps.description: Validate that OpenMetadata can reach and authenticate with Databend.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to connect to Databend. Validate the host and credentials.

steps.name: GetDatabases
steps.description: Validate access to the Databend default catalog.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to access the Databend default catalog.

steps.name: GetSchemas
steps.description: List Databend databases available to the user.

steps.name: GetTables
steps.description: List tables in a Databend database.

steps.name: GetViews
steps.description: List views in a Databend database.

steps.name: GetLineage
steps.description: Read Databend lineage from system_history.lineage_history. Required only for lineage ingestion.
steps.errorMessage: Failed to read system_history.lineage_history. Lineage ingestion needs Databend v1.2.933 or later with `[log.history] on = true` and `[lineage] on = true`, an Enterprise license, and SELECT on system_history. Other ingestion workflows are not affected.
